label: pjm 20f probe mid045
definition: run 20f midpoint probe: curve-mid 0.45 on run-19 config, 2024 only (vs run-19 2024 at 0.35) — watches coal-total 2024 knife edge and LMP 2024. Outcome vs run-19 2024 (mid 0.35): gas +15.66->+14.70, COAL_BIT -4.27->-3.79, coal-total -5.50->-5.04 (knife edge widens), LMP -12.1%->-11.6% (+0.13 $/MWh). With 20e: PJM mid response is monotone — higher mid lifts coal and LMP in both cheap- and dear-gas years. 0.45 adopted as the tuned PJM midpoint for run 21 (WC 2025 cost ~+0.04, countered via waste sigmoid).
